your_book:
Friday was a tale of two software names dominating the action. Adobe (ADBE) surged +6.0% to $3,523 — the single biggest dollar contributor today — and ServiceNow (NOW) added +7.29%, pushing its value to $2,269. Both moves are notable because the session backdrop included fresh reports that OpenAI is building an AI-agent product called Presence aimed squarely at enterprise back-office automation — a direct narrative threat to both names. The fact that ADBE and NOW rallied hard into that headline is either genuine conviction or a short-squeeze; either way, the AI-disruption risk flag on both names did not go away. Abbott (ABT) added another +2.4%, extending an already solid +19.3% open gain and continuing to do exactly what a capital-preservation anchor should do.

The damage came from Rocket Lab (RKLB), which dropped -8.67% today and now sits -30.1% in the book — the deepest unrealised loss by far, and the system rates it AVOID with a QARP of 46.4. That combination (underwater, deteriorating momentum, lowest quality score, flagged AVOID) is a structural mismatch for a capital-preservation mandate. Uber (UBER) fell -4.32% and is now -7.9% in the hole, while Broadcom (AVGO) slipped -2.88%. Lululemon (LULU) caught a +3.39% bounce but remains -10.5% underwater with a live guidance-cut flag and the next catalyst not until September 2.

Overall the book carries a -$793.67 / -3.65% unrealised loss on $20,964 in assets with essentially zero cash cushion ($0.38). The concentration risk is real: ADBE at 16.8% and ZTS/ABT/NOW each near 11–12% means four names represent over half the book. Watch BSX closely — the FY26 growth guidance was slashed and the next print is July 29, just days away.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated, -30.1% loss, fell another -8.67% today — no thesis alignment
attention.note: RKLB is the only AVOID-rated name in the book, carries the largest unrealised loss (-30.1%), dropped sharply again today, and scores a 46.4 QARP — it is misaligned with a capital-preservation mandate on every metric.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed; earnings due July 29 — elevated flag, already -7.6% underwater
attention.note: Boston Scientific cut FY26 growth guidance from 10.5% to 7–8.5% with management guiding flat through Q3; the next print is in five days and the position is already in the red.

attention.headline: Biggest single-day gain (+7.29%) arrived on a day the OpenAI Presence threat was reported
attention.note: NOW is the third-largest weight at 10.8% and rallied hard into a directly competitive AI-agent headline — either the market is dismissing the threat or the move is fragile; the concentration amplifies the downside if sentiment reverses.

attention.headline: Bounce of +3.39% doesn't resolve the live guidance-cut flag — still -10.5% in the hole
attention.note: Lululemon's FY guide was cut with five straight negative Americas comp prints and tariff margin pressure; today's move is noise ahead of the September 2 catalyst.
